LESSON: MATRICES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: ALGEBRA
Topic 2.1: Matrices
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Matrices, part of ALGEBRA in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How do we use matrices in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Matrices together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Understands and respects diversity; A learner speaks clearly and effectively using

appropriate language as they discuss use of tables to represent matrices.

● Learning to learn: Sets own goal; A learner reflects on their own experience as they arrange items or elements in rows and

columns to form matrices.

● Integrity: A learner enhances discipline as they organise objects in rows and columns and give the order of the matrix.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Socio-Economic and Environmental Issues: Social and economic issues; A learner discusses the use of tables such as

football league tables and shopping lists.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the skill of matrices to a similar concept of generating tables of results in sports and refers to

league schedules in Creative Arts.

Suggested learning resources:

● marbles, Counters, multiplication table
